blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards ordinarily spreads a single advantage over a whole trajectory, a granularity too coarse to isolate the few decisions on which success in a long, multi-turn interaction actually turns. Privileged self-distillation supplies denser supervision, but it leaves unanswered how a set of local teacher-student discrepancies should be converted into credit along a sequence. We introduce AgentOPSD, a critic-free scheme that assigns credit recursively, one interaction turn at a time. Inside a turn, the token-level log-probability gaps between a skill-conditioned self-teacher and the student are summed, and that sum acts as evidence in a recursive Bayesian update carried out in log-odds space; the resulting revisions reallocate the outcome-derived advantage across turns through a multiplier that is bounded and preserves its sign. With Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B as policy backbones on ALFWorld, the method improves consistently on GRPO and on self-distillation baselines, and attains 89.1% success at the 7B scale. Ablations attribute the gain to aggregating evidence at turn boundaries and to making the belief revision depend on history, rather than to the local gap by itself.
blocks.zh: 用可核查的奖励加强学习通常将单一优势分布在整个轨迹上,颗粒性过于粗糙,无法孤立在长期、多回合互动中真正取得成功的少数决定。 私人的自我消化提供了更密集的监管,但是,对于如何按照顺序将一系列当地师生差异转换成信贷,却没有答案。 我们引入了AgentOPSD, 一个无批评性的计划, 递归地分配信用, 一次一个交互转折。 反过来,技能条件好的自学教师与学生之间的象征性对数概率差距被归纳,总和在对数空间进行的巴耶斯语递归更新中起到证据作用;由此产生的修订通过一个限定并保持其标志的乘数,将结果产生的优势重新分配。 以Quen2.5-3B和Quen2.5-7B作为ALFWorld的政策支柱,该方法在GRPO和自毁基准上不断改进,在7B规模上取得了89.1%的成功. 偏差将收益归结为在转弯边界汇集证据,使信仰修正取决于历史,而不是地方差距本身。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Teaching large language models to act as agents has become a principal avenue for extending their capacity on difficult tasks ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Comanici et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2026b ) . The setting is not static single-turn reasoning: an agent inhabits a partially observable world and keeps acting, choosing from what it currently sees and then observing the world’s response before deciding again ( Shen et al., 2023 ; Shi et al., 2025 ; Jimenez et al., 2023 ) . Verification, moreover, often becomes possible only once a trajectory has finished, so a training procedure must infer the role of one intermediate step from a single sparse terminal signal. Yet steps inside a trajectory are far from interchangeable: a successful run can contain redundant, spurious or misleading actions, and a failing run can contain sensible reasoning.
blocks.zh: 教授大型语言模型充当代理人已成为扩大能力的主要途径(Guo等,2025;Team等,2025;Yang等,2025;Comanici等,2025;Team等,2026b)。 环境不是静态的单转推理:一个代理人居住在一个部分可观察的世界,并继续行动,从它目前看到的事物中作出选择,然后观察世界的反应,然后再决定(Shen等人,2023年;Shi等人,2025年;Jimenez等人,2023年)。 此外,核查往往只有在轨迹完成后才有可能进行,因此,训练程序必须从一个稀少的终端信号中推断出一个中间步骤的作用。 然而,轨迹内的步骤远非可互换:成功的跑会包含多余的、虚假的或误导性的行动,而失败跑会包含合理的推理。

blocks.en: Group-relative policy optimization, with GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) being the canonical instance alongside its agentic descendants ( Dong et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2025 ) , derives a single advantage for the whole trajectory from the outcome reward and applies it unchanged at every position. Credit that is spread this flatly cannot separate a handful of pivotal decisions from routine operations around them, and the distortion worsens as turns accumulate. Per-turn credit is therefore a prerequisite both for locating decisions that actually drive the outcome and for supervising long horizons at finer granularity.
blocks.zh: 集团相对政策优化,由GRPO(Shao等,2024;Yu等,2025)与其代理后代(Dong等,2025;Feng等,2025)一起成为犬科案例,从结果奖励中获得整个轨迹的单一优势,并在各个职位上适用不变. 这种分散的功劳不能把少数关键决定与周围的日常行动分开,而且随着转折的累积,扭曲情况会恶化。 因此,每个回合的信贷既是确定实际推动结果的决定的先决条件,也是以更细微的颗粒度监督长视野的先决条件。

blocks.en: Denser token-level supervision has been pursued along a separate line. In on-policy distillation ( Ye et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Team et al., 2026a ) , a student is trained under a teacher on rollouts of its own, while the self -distillation variants of this idea ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ) do away with any separate teacher by conditioning one and the same policy on privileged information that exists only during training ( Lu et al., 2026b ) . Reinforcement learning has likewise used such signals as an auxiliary supervision source.
blocks.zh: 丹瑟令牌级别的监督被沿着一条单独的线进行. 在政策分解(Ye等,2026;Yang等,2026;Team等,2026a)中,一名学生在教师领导下接受自行推广的培训,而这种想法的自消化变体(Zhao等,2026;He等,2026)则通过对仅在培训期间才存在的特权信息设定一个条件和相同的政策来取消任何单独的教师(Lu等,2026b.). 强化学习同样也使用这种信号作为辅助监督来源。

blocks.en: Two mismatches appear once OPSD meets agentic reinforcement learning. The first concerns granularity: token-level signals sit awkwardly against an interaction in which many tokens jointly constitute one action and the environment reacts only when a turn ends. The second concerns memory: even step-aware methods score each turn separately ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , leaving earlier evidence unused. What must be solved, then, is how local OPSD signals become turn-level credit that depends on history.
blocks.zh: 一旦OPSD满足代理强化学习,就会出现两种不匹配. 第一个问题涉及颗粒性:象征级信号与一种相互作用相矛盾,即许多象征共同构成一个行动,环境只有在转弯后才作出反应。 二是记忆:甚至步入认知方法的分数,每个回转分别进行(张等,2026年),使更早的证据被使用. 因此,必须解决的是,本地的OPSD信号如何成为取决于历史的回合级信用.

blocks.en: We begin from the position that what should govern a turn’s credit is not its local signal taken on its own, but how far that signal moves the estimated probability of eventual success . Precision comes from reading the per-turn self-distillation gap as newly arrived evidence driving a Bayesian belief update ( Åström, 1965 ; Kaelbling et al., 1998 ) . The belief state is then the probability of eventual task success given the history so far.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们的立场是,应该如何管理转折的信用,不是它自己掌握的当地信号,而是该信号将如何移动最终成功的估计概率。 准确性来自读取自转自沉的空隙,因为新得到的证据驱使贝叶斯人信仰更新(Aström, 1965; Kaelbling等, 1998)。 从迄今为止的历史来看,信仰状态是最终任务取得成功的概率。

blocks.en: This observation leads us to AgentOPSD ( agentic on-policy self-distillation ), a method that assigns credit turn by turn in long-horizon agents. Token-level teacher–student log-probability gaps are first pooled by AgentOPSD into turn-level evidence. A Bayesian belief state, initialized at the mean group success rate, is then revised recursively turn after turn in log-odds space, with neither extra rollouts nor a learned critic required. The verifier fixes the direction of optimization globally, while the belief updates redistribute the trajectory-level learning signal over individual turns. AgentOPSD is evaluated on ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ) at two model scales, and Figure 1 shows it to outperform GRPO and strong self-distillation baselines consistently. The ablations point to two sources of the improvement: pooling token-level signals at the turn boundaries that coincide with environment transitions, and reframing a gap that stands on its own as a revision of belief that recurs along the trajectory.
blocks.zh: 这一观察使我们找到了AgentOPSD(即政策上的自我消化代理),这种方法将信用逐个地分配成长距离代理。 顶级教师 - 学生日志概率差距由代理商首先集合 OPSD成为转向级证据. A Bayesian信仰状态,以平均组分成功率初始化,然后在转回对数空间后进行回转修改,不需要额外推出,也不需要学习的批评者. 核查者确定全球优化的方向,而信念更新则将轨迹级学习信号在单个转弯上重新分配。 AgentOPSD在ALFWorld(Shridhar等人,2020年)上通过两个模型尺度进行评价,图1显示它的业绩一直超过GRPO和强大的自沉基线。 浮出水面表明有两个改进来源:在转弯边界上集合标志级信号,这与环境过渡相吻合;以及将一个差距重新定位为对沿轨迹重现的信念进行修正。

blocks.en: We summarize the contributions of this work below:
blocks.zh: 我们总结这项工作的贡献如下:

blocks.en: • Credit at the level of a turn is cast as the amount by which one turn revises the estimated chance that the run ends in success. Carrying the recursion in log-odds space ties the evidence of one turn to a Bayesian update applied repeatedly, and makes plain that a self-distillation gap on its own does not amount to sequential credit. • We propose AgentOPSD , which collapses teacher–student log-probability gaps at the token level into turn-level evidence that lines up with environment transitions, then carries it recursively through the belief over trajectory success; neither extra rollouts nor a learned critic is required. • On ALFWorld, at two model scales, experiments together with ablations show AgentOPSD to outperform GRPO and strong self-distillation baselines consistently, and the ablations confirm that aggregating at turn boundaries and revising belief by recursion bring benefits that are complementary.
blocks.zh: • 以转弯一级获得的信贷,作为一次转弯修订跑跑成功的估计机会的数额。 将重复的对数空间连接到一次转向反复应用的巴耶斯语更新的证据,并表明自行消化的缺口并不等于连续信用。 我们提出AgentOPSD,它使教师 — — 学生在象征性层面上的日志概率差距崩溃,成为与环境过渡相接的转折级证据,然后通过对轨迹成功的信念递相传;不需要额外推出,也不需要有学问的批评者。 二. 支助 在ALFWorld上,在两个模型尺度上,实验与平面图显示AgentOPSD能够持续地超过GRPO和强大的自沉基线,平面图证实,以折向边界和通过再现来修正信念的集合可以带来互补的好处。

blocks.en: Neither outcome-conditional behavioral distribution can be inspected directly, so the Bayesian evidence has to be recovered after the fact. We obtain it from a per-turn self-distillation contrast that is actually computable: a privileged self-teacher, associated with success, is set against the ordinary student policy. blocks.en:
AgentOPSD and the privileged baselines consume an identical pool of retrieved skills, so what
separates them is chiefly the way a skill-induced teacher–student discrepancy is converted into a
learning signal. On ALFWorld, AgentOPSD beats every baseline it is compared against at both
model scales. Holding the available information constant in this fashion localizes the origin of
the improvement: a gap measured locally between teacher and student does not by itself amount to a
dependable credit signal. Once that gap is accumulated into a belief state and credit is granted
according to how the belief is revised, the turns that actually alter the predicted outcome are
pinned down far more precisely.

blocks.en: 4.1 Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Agents
blocks.zh: 4.1 长视线人员强化学习

blocks.en:
Work on RL with verifiable rewards initially targeted single-turn
reasoning ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026a ) ,
then progressed toward agents that act across many steps in embodied
text environments ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) . Only a sparse
terminal reward is available in such settings, so identifying the turns
that merit credit becomes particularly hard. Vanilla GRPO avoids this
question altogether: it spreads one trajectory-level advantage evenly
across all turns. GiGPO ( Feng et al., 2025 ) improves matters on the
reward side by pairing episode-level advantages with step-level
counterparts estimated from anchor states that reappear across
trajectories. AgentOPSD , by contrast, grounds its turn-level
evidence in privileged teacher–student likelihood gaps, and
apportions credit through recursive updates of a belief state. The two
approaches therefore rely on complementary sources of
information—environment rewards in the case of GiGPO,
self-distillation evidence in the case of AgentOPSD .

blocks.en: 4.2 Distilling On-Policy Signals
blocks.zh: 4.2 减少政策上的信号

blocks.en:
In on-policy distillation, a policy is optimized on its own rollouts
with guidance from a
teacher ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Gu et al., 2026 ; Wen et al., 2023 ) . Newer
self-distillation variants drop the separate teacher entirely,
conditioning the teacher branch instead on privileged information that
is accessible only during
training ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026b ) . The
teacher–student log-probability gap produced in this way has lately
been brought into RLVR in the form of local supervision, where it may be
reweighted, annealed on a schedule, or folded into a denser
reward ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ) .
Throughout this literature the gap is mostly handled as a token-level or
step-level quantity. Yet such local signals align poorly with action
turns, whose contribution depends on evidence gathered across earlier
interactions. StepOPSD ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) moves in this direction
by pooling the teacher–student signal across action-centered step

blocks.en: 4.3 Assigning Credit over Long Horizons
blocks.zh: 4.3 将信贷转让给地平线

blocks.en:
Assigning credit over long horizons is a problem with a long history.
PPO trains a value function and, through GAE, converts it into per-step
temporal-difference signals ( Schulman et al., 2017 ; Schulman et al., 2016 ) .
Under sparse, delayed rewards, two families of methods recover
intermediate structure: return-decomposition approaches such as RUDDER
push the terminal reward back onto the steps responsible for
it ( Arjona-Medina et al., 2019 ) , whereas process reward models and
Monte-Carlo credit schemes like VinePPO infer intermediate value from
additional rollouts or a learned
scorer ( Cui et al., 2025 ; Kazemnejad et al., 2024 ) . Both regain per-step
resolution at exactly the cost GRPO was meant to avoid—an extra
trained critic, reward model, or heavy rollout budget. AgentOPSD restores a per-turn value signal inside the critic-free, group-relative
framework, and pays only for one teacher forward pass. Here the belief
state plays a role analogous to GAE’s value baseline, and its per-turn
revision parallels the TD signal, all without learning a value network.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
This paper tackles credit assignment for long-horizon language agents,
where a trajectory-level reward can hardly separate decisive actions
from routine or redundant ones. The central claim of this work is that
a turn’s credit should capture more than its local signal: it should
capture the way in which that signal revises an accumulated belief about
the trajectory’s eventual success. AgentOPSD realizes this idea by
aggregating token-level self-distillation gaps within turn boundaries
that follow the environment’s structure, and by recursively maintaining
a belief about trajectory success in log-odds space. The resulting
belief revisions spread the trajectory-level advantage across turns,
requiring neither additional rollouts nor a learned critic. On ALFWorld and at two model scales, AgentOPSD consistently outperforms GRPO as well as strong self-distillation
baselines, and ablations verify that turn-level aggregation and
history-dependent belief revision both matter. Overall, these results
suggest that recursive belief updating offers a simple yet effective
route to recovering fine-grained temporal credit for critic-free
agentic RL.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 限制

blocks.en:
The empirical evaluation is confined to one text-based embodied benchmark,
ALFWorld, and to two checkpoints of a single model family. We therefore make
no claim that the observed gains carry over to other environments, larger
model scales, or other modalities. The formulation presupposes that turn
boundaries can be read off the environment’s interaction structure and that
a skill-conditioned self-teacher is available during training; settings with
continuous feedback or without a usable teacher signal would call for a
different construction. Group-relative advantages still require several
rollouts per prompt, so the approach does not remove the sampling cost of
GRPO-style training. The analysis in the appendix is developed under
simplifying assumptions about the belief update and does not establish
optimality or convergence of the complete training objective. Hyperparameter
sensitivity is measured through one-dimensional sweeps around a single
operating point; interactions between the knobs and behaviour at horizons
beyond those present in ALFWorld remain unexamined. Finally, success rate is
the only reported metric, and may not reflect other desiderata such as sample
efficiency or robustness to distribution shift.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 summarizes one AgentOPSD training iteration at the granularity of turns.
